docs.title: UP TGT PGT Study Portal
docs.text:
A focused study workspace for UP TGT and UP PGT preparation.

Use this portal to publish clear, revision-friendly content:

  • 📚 Syllabus and exam structure
  • 🧪 Subject notes and chapter summaries
  • ✅ Practice MCQs
  • 📢 Vacancy, admit card, answer key, and result updates
  • 📝 Online tests and mock-test links
  • 🔎 Books, video channels, websites, and previous papers

docs.title: Start Here
docs.text:
• :material-clipboard-text-outline: Know the syllabus

    Begin with the syllabus overview and mark the topics you need to cover.

  • :material-notebook-edit-outline: Study by subject

    Build your revision library in Notes, one chapter at a time.

  • :material-checkbox-multiple-marked-outline: Practice actively

    Test recall with the MCQ hub and keep an error log.

  • :material-calendar-check: Track the exam cycle

    Check Job Updates for official announcements.

Verify official information

Always confirm dates, eligibility, vacancies, and results on the official recruiting authority website before acting on an update.

docs.title: Content workflow
docs.text:
1. Choose a subject or exam section.
  2. Add one focused note or question set.
  3. Link supporting sources at the bottom.
  4. Update the relevant navigation entry in mkdocs.yml when adding a new page.

docs.text: Write one page per concept or chapter. Keep each page easy to revise in ten minutes.

docs.title: Recommended note format
docs.text:

  2. Core concepts
  3. Worked example
  4. Common mistake
  5. Five-line revision summary
  6. Practice questions

docs.text: Prioritize depth, spaced revision, and written practice for advanced subject content.

docs.title: Weekly loop
docs.text:
• Cover one advanced unit from the official syllabus.
  • Create a two-page summary with definitions and examples.
  • Solve previous-paper questions by topic.
  • Review errors and update your formula or concept sheet.

docs.title: What to publish here
docs.text:
• Exam overview and latest notification
  • Subject-wise preparation guidance
  • Common mistakes and revision checklists

Start with the eligibility criteria, then review the exam pattern.

docs.title: A simple weekly loop
docs.text:
1. Read one syllabus unit.
  2. Write a short concept note.
  3. Solve a timed MCQ set.
  4. Record errors and revise them after 48 hours.
  5. Take one mixed test at the end of the week.
